command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- operating system ---'
sed -n '1,8p' /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- execution identity ---'
id
printf '%s\n' '--- required account ---'
getent passwd inventory-worker || true
id inventory-worker 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- worker binary ---'
ls -l /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-resource-worker
file /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-resource-worker
printf '%s\n' '--- matching processes and units ---'
ps -eo pid,user,comm,args | grep '[o]s-comparison-resource-worker' || true
systemctl list-unit-files --no-legend | grep -E 'resource|inventory|worker' || true
printf '%s\n' '--- init and cgroup ---'
ps -p 1 -o pid=,comm=,args=
stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup
systemctl --version | sed -n '1p'
